name: i-just-want-to-code
description: One-command engineering workflow on any stack: ship a branch (PR/MR, reviewers, auto-merge, ticket status, time log, team message), safe pull, time logging and weekly check, tickets from drafts, build and distribute, VPN wait, and your own custom commands. Claude sets it up for your tools; every value, step, hook and message is configurable, with dry runs, trusted repo config and OS-keychain secrets.
